title: Reading a .env file
hints: Simple values work. Look at what's special about the value that gets cut short: which character appears inside it?
`line.split("=")` splits at **every** `=`, so `"A=b=c"` becomes three pieces. Destructuring `[key, value]` keeps only the first two and throws the rest away.
Collect the leftover pieces and glue them back: `const [key, ...rest] = line.split("=");` then use `rest.join("=")` as the value.
